# Draft:The Roblox Innovation Awards

The Roblox Innovation Awards (formerly and colloquially known as the Bloxy Awards) is an annual award show that goes along with the Roblox Developer Conference (RDC). The Innovation Awards began in 2013 and has been held ever since. The awards were also streamed on Twitch but now on YouTube.  The show takes the biggest creators and game developers on Roblox to attend. Some of the shows are Lost media as the stream was taken down.
History
Background
The Roblox Innovation Awards is an annual event held by Roblox. It aims to recognize the artistic, creative, and social abilities of its playerbase. Originally intended for video creators and animators, the program has expanded to officially include artists, social media influencers, and game creators. Near the end of each year, the Roblox community can send in their vote for each category, where (for most categories) five final nominees are picked at a later date to finalize the voting process. The results are then streamed on platforms such as Twitch and YouTube.
The first Bloxys was the 2013 Hall of Fame and the ROBLOX Film Festival, shown during the BLOXcon 2013 event. Unlike future editions of the Bloxys, this was the only Bloxys that had winners revealed at different times and locations (except for the Virtual BLOXcon 2013).
As of 2022, Bloxys have been succeeded by the Roblox Innovation Awards. Unlike the Bloxy Awards, the Roblox Innovation Awards is an in-person event that is held during Roblox Developers Conferences.
